verdict.rationale: Spline documents a pen tool that 'works in a familiar way to other 2D or UI design tools' and a Hana 2D canvas for interfaces built on vector networks, so the core pen and path capability is there. However, the documented boolean operations apply to 3D objects, not 2D vectors, and nothing covers precise alignment or distribution tools. missing for 10: 2D vector boolean operations, precise alignment/distribution tooling, detailed path-editing docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of vector tools for interface work.
